title: Tourist Season, 2013 · checkout
logline: The guest checking out at 7 AM as Wood's shift ends: the key, the receipt, and the guest asking to have the pad's bay. Wood tears it off and gives it to him. The guest says the name. Wood says the other one.

panels.composition: The desk at 7 AM. The GUEST with a bag sliding a key across. WOOD tired.

balloons.text: You draw that bay last night?

image.prompt: a guest with a bag sliding a key across a motel desk to a tired clerk in a maroon polo, black ink with one spot tone

panels.composition: WOOD tearing the page off the pad.

image.prompt: a man in a maroon polo tearing a page off a pad at a motel desk, black ink with one spot tone

panels.composition: The GUEST taking it, reading the corner.

image.prompt: a guest holding a drawn page and reading the small signature in its corner, black ink with one spot tone

panels.composition: WOOD, already writing the next receipt.

image.prompt: a tired clerk in a maroon polo writing a receipt without looking up, black ink with one spot tone

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: 'Arthur' from a stranger; 'Wood' back. Hum line under.
